functional_summary: Contractile working myocardium of the ventricles; high sarcomeric gene expression (MYH7, MYL2, MYL3) and force generation
Ventricular cardiomyocytes with elevated mitochondrial and oxidative phosphorylation programs supporting high energy demand
Second metabolically active ventricular state; high oxidative metabolism with a transcriptional profile distinct from state 1
Early, less differentiated cardiomyocytes with low sarcomeric maturity and a fetal gene program; precursors of mature states
Cycling cardiomyocytes (MKI67, TOP2A) driving myocardial growth by hyperplasia during development
Contractile atrial myocardium (NPPA, MYL7, MYL4); atrial contraction and natriuretic peptide secretion
Atrial cardiomyocytes with elevated mitochondrial and oxidative metabolism programs
Myocardial interstitial fibroblasts; produce and remodel extracellular matrix and give structural support to the myocardium
Fibroblasts of the outflow tract and great vessel roots; build the elastic and collagenous matrix of the arterial pole
Fibroblasts of the fibrous atrioventricular annulus; form the cardiac skeleton and electrically insulate atria from ventricles
Fibroblast state marked by high PDE4C expression; suggests altered cAMP signalling, exact function not well defined
Cycling fibroblasts (MKI67, TOP2A) expanding the stromal compartment during heart growth
Mesothelial outer layer of the heart (WT1, TBX18, UPK3B); source of paracrine signals and progenitors for the myocardial wall
Cells that left the epicardium by EMT and invade the myocardium; progenitors of fibroblasts and coronary mural cells
Valve interstitial-like mesenchyme from endocardial cushions; deposits proteoglycan-rich matrix and remodels the valve leaflets
Mesenchymal cells associated with the pericardium; connective tissue support of the pericardial layer
Smooth muscle of the aorta and pulmonary trunk roots; provides vessel wall tone and elastic matrix at the arterial pole
Smooth muscle cells of the coronary arteries; regulate coronary vessel tone and stabilise the arterial wall
Perivascular cells of the microvasculature (PDGFRB, RGS5); stabilise capillaries and regulate endothelial function
Endothelial lining of the cardiac chambers (NPR3, NRG1); signals to myocardium for trabeculation and compaction
Endocardial cells over the cushions; undergo EndMT to generate valve and septal mesenchyme
Capillary endothelium of the myocardium; oxygen and nutrient exchange with cardiomyocytes
Endothelium of large vessels (arteries and veins, including coronaries); conduit blood flow and vessel wall signalling
Endothelial state marked by high PDE4C expression; suggests altered cAMP signalling, exact function not well defined
Cardiac lymphatic endothelium (PROX1, LYVE1); interstitial fluid drainage and immune cell trafficking
Cell state defined by high thymosin beta-10 expression; actin-cytoskeleton remodelling signature, lineage identity not well defined
Second TMSB10-high state; similar cytoskeletal signature with a distinct transcriptional profile, lineage identity not well defined
Neural crest-derived neuroblasts and differentiating autonomic neurons (STMN2, PHOX2B); autonomic innervation of the heart

description: Schwann cell precursors and glial cells
functional_summary: Neural crest-derived Schwann cell precursors and glia (SOX10, PLP1); support and guide developing cardiac nerves
Macrophages, monocytes and related myeloid cells; tissue remodelling, phagocytosis and support of vascular and conduction development
T, B and NK/innate lymphoid cells; early immune surveillance, a minor population in the developing heart
